display_name: Daniel of the Castle of Patras

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Δανιήλ ὁ ἐν τῷ κάστρῳ τῶν Πατρῶν», with the rank word left off. The life page shortens the byname to «τον ἐν Κάστρῳ».

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ἔζησε τον ΙΑ' αιώνα μ.Χ.» — the page gives the century and no year.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Δανιήλ ὁ ἐν τῷ κάστρῳ τῶν Πατρῶν»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's nine other men of the name: this is the eleventh-century ascetic of Patras whom the life of Nicetas of Thebes — the entry beside him on the same day — met in that city. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
